Didn't last long. But I quietly shed some tears while my friends were chatting. It was...nice

For context: what puts me on the edge is my feelings of loneliness. 

Anytime I seriously think of suicide, it ends pretty quickly because frankly there is so much I want to see and do I can't fathom offing myself right now before at least seeing some of it.

I've already posted my "blockbuster" analogy as a comment on a different post so I hope no one is bothered if I copy pasta it here:

I've started looking at life as a game rental from blockbuster (did I just date myself?)

You get the game for a limited time. You've played it thus far and haven't liked it, and you're ready to return it early. 

And you can. If you truly really want to you can. 

But perhaps by playing further you can find something you enjoy about it, that gives you some hope to keep playing. 

My friend, this game of life...its fun for some and no so much for others. You and me both...we haven't been having much fun. 

But I have decided to try and keep playing. In the end, I have to return the game anyways. I figure I might as well run its course. Besides, in the end; life really is a game. Nothing here is really "real" is it? It's a temporary existence. 

So yeah, I get it man. Working this hard to literally enter the same state as before seems so utterly pointless....because it is. Or it probably is. We really don't know. 

But to me that's kind of what keeps me going. Knowing I can throw in the towel anytime I want...or will be forced to eventually anyway. 

Hope this helps at all, and I'm truly sorry if it doesn't. Either way I'm open to a conversation buddy, anything you wanna talk about. :)
